Thanks Angela — this is a helpful start. A few items we need clarified before we lock the block: 

1) Room mix: we need 24 king rooms, 4 doubles, 2 suites (suite upgrades confirmed), and 2 ADA-accessible rooms. Please confirm which inventory you propose for the wellness floor versus ADA.
2) Rate guarantee: can you move the suite guarantee to 14 days (instead of 21) with a small attrition penalty? Our execs often confirm late.
3) Master bill: we prefer a single master bill for incidentals and one for food/AV if possible. I attached our preferred template (Ridgeway_MasterBill_Template.xlsx) — can you confirm you can consume that format?
4) Arrival windows: early check-in for two senior execs (arriving 9/23 @ 08:30) — can you tentatively hold early-check rooms?
5) Wellness: will yoga mats and refrigerated mini-fridges be available on request in wellness-floor rooms? Also any quiet-floor/low-footfall floors you recommend for execs?

Miles — can TravelOps handle collecting the traveler preferences and build the initial rooming manifest? Marissa — see note below for guest-level dietary and wellness flags.

Thanks,
